items.rationale: Escape of water from the washing machine is covered under 2.4.2; cleaning affected surfaces is a repair cost under 7.1.7(h). Rate is a split of the Case 12 combined line (423-514).
The hallway is an affected room, so cleaning it falls under 7.1.7(h). Rate is a split of the Case 12 combined line.
Confirming the source no longer leaks is covered under 7.1.7(e), even though the appliance itself is not insured.
Taking down and disposing of affected components is covered under 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1. Rate is a split of the Case 12 combined line.
Skirting is a building component (4.2.2) and the boards were damaged, so like-for-like replacement is covered. Rate is the remainder of the Case 12 combined line.
The bedroom was not reached by the water, so the work is outside the affected parts and excluded under 3.5 and 7.1.5.
Moisture measurement is covered under 7.1.7(b). Rate taken from the Case 21 moisture-measurement line (153-178).
Drying the affected rooms is covered under 7.1.7(b). Lines 7-10 together are calibrated to the Case 12 drying threshold of 605-680.
Hire of drying equipment is covered under 7.1.7(e). It is not a duplicate of the drying labour line.
Trade labour is covered under 7.1.7(g). Per the price prior, 4 h x about 38 = 152.
The basement is not an affected room; under 7.1.7(b) drying does not extend to other rooms, and 7.1.5 applies.

Covered under 5.2.6, but the painting is not scheduled, so the limit is EUR 1,000 net (1,190 gross) per item. That limit is set first against restoration, which likely exhausts it, leaving this line probably nil.
This shares the 5.2.6 limit of 1,190 gross; any balance left after restoration goes to the measures in invoice order.
This shares the 5.2.6 limit, applied after restoration and the earlier invoice lines; it is likely exhausted.
Under 5.2.6 the limit is set first against restoration. A high-value restoration likely exceeds EUR 1,000 net, so the line is capped at 1,190 gross.
This painting was unaffected by the leak, so the line is not attributable to the damage (7.1.5, 7.1.8(e)).
Administrative and processing charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b), and this line type was never indemnified in earlier cases.
